# Classic Styles Salon & Day Spa

> Family-owned hair salon and day spa at 4116 Grand Blvd, Unit 1, New Port Richey, FL 34652.
> Serving Pasco County and the Gulf Coast from Grand Blvd for 25 years; owner Tammy has 35+ years behind the chair. Rated 5.0 stars across 52 Google
> reviews. Walk-ins welcome; appointments by call or text at (727) 487-4475.
> Hours: Tue–Fri 9:00–5:00, Sat 9:00–3:00, Sun–Mon closed.
> Owner and master stylist: Tammy (35+ years behind the chair).

## Services & Pricing

- [Home](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/): Full service menu, reviews, team and directions.
- [Haircuts & Styling](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/haircuts-styling/): Women's, men's and children's haircuts from $25; precision cuts, blowouts, fades.
- [Hair Color & Balayage](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/hair-color-balayage/): Full color, highlights, lowlights and balayage from $60; free consults.
- [Deep-Conditioning Treatments](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/treatments/): Moisture and repair treatments for sun-, salt- and chlorine-stressed Florida hair.
- [Perms](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/perms/): Body waves, spiral curls and classic perms; a rare specialty, 35+ years of practice.
- [Nail Salon](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/nail-salon/): Manicures and spa pedicures at our New Port Richey nail salon.
- [Weddings](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/weddings/): Bridal updos, braids and whole wedding party hair, plus quinceañeras and proms; by consultation.
- [Try a Color Live](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/try-on/): Free, private live-camera mirror to preview hair colors on yourself before booking.
- [Gift Certificates](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/gift-certificates/): Gift certificates for any amount or a specific service; call or text, pick up at the front desk.

## Hair Advice

- [Hair advice hub](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/advice/): Plain, honest hair articles from a family salon with 35+ years of experience.
- [How to keep hair smooth in Florida humidity](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/advice/hair-humidity-florida/): Why humidity causes frizz and what helps: washing, drying, light products, heat habits, smoothing treatments.
- [How long does a perm last?](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/advice/how-long-does-a-perm-last/): Most perms last 3-6 months; perms today vs the '80s, body wave vs spiral, aftercare.
- [Wedding hair timeline](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/advice/wedding-hair-timeline/): When to book, trial runs, what to bring, bridal party planning and on-location styling.
- [Fixing a box-dye mistake](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/advice/fixing-box-dye/): What to do and not do, why color correction can take stages, free color consultation.
- [How Much Does Balayage Cost in New Port Richey?](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/advice/balayage-cost-new-port-richey/): What balayage costs in New Port Richey, what changes the price, and how to get an exact quote by text before you book. Color at Classic Styles starts at $60.
- [How Much Does Color Correction Cost?](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/advice/color-correction-cost/): Why color correction is priced by consultation, what affects the cost, how many visits it can take, and how to get a free plan and price at Classic Styles in New Port Richey.
- [How to Choose a Hair Salon in New Port Richey](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/advice/choosing-a-hair-salon-new-port-richey/): A plain checklist for choosing a hair salon in New Port Richey and Pasco County: reviews, consultations, experience, prices said up front, and what to ask before you book.
- [Gray Blending vs. Full Gray Coverage: Which Is Right for You?](https://classicstylesdayspas.com/advice/gray-blending/): Gray blending or full coverage? How each works, how often you need touch-ups, and how to choose, from stylists in New Port Richey with 35+ years of experience.
